correctness.rationale: The exact finite graph has 27 vertices and 42 edges. I reviewed complete verify.cpp: exhaustive include/exclude generation enumerates all 7,594,360 nonempty graph matchings; the greedy face toggle matches pairs, the complete oriented 61,837,314 Hasse incidences are checked via Kahn topological sorting, and the resulting 262 critical cells consist of one 0-cell, 212 in dimension 8 and 49 in dimension 9. For each critical 9-cell the signed Morse boundary recursion on 8-faces uses the exact incidence signs and acyclic matching; 49 sequential integer unit pivots reduce the 212-by-49 differential to [I_49;0_163], with max growth 4. In that 7-connected Morse CW range, Hurewicz identifies 9-cell attaching maps with their degree vectors, so unimodular cancellation gives wedge of 163 S^8. Independent matching-polynomial DP over the original 27-vertex graph (not the supplied enumeration) recomputed all 13 face-vector entries, total 7,594,360, and Euler 164. Full 800MB C++ enumeration was NOT rerun in this execution; saved output matches inspected algorithm but this limit is explicit.
